UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Supervisor or site manager configuration and shift defaults.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

projectName.description: Default work site or project name.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: Registered field worker in the supervisor's roster.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

active.description: Whether the worker is currently active on the roster.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Daily verified attendance proof entry for a worker.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

siteName.description: Work site where attendance was verified.

checkOutTimeLabel.description: Optional formatted local check-out time string.

locationSummary.description: Optional GPS coordinate or site location verification summary.

photoUriString.description: Optional local photo URI reference selected via Photo Picker.

notes.description: Optional supervisor or worker proof notes.

checkInTimestamp.description: Optional authoritative server timestamp of check-in.

checkOutTimestamp.description: Optional authoritative server timestamp of check-out.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: User site profile and shift configuration.

/users/{userId}/workers/{workerId}.description: Workers registered under the authenticated user's site.

/users/{userId}/attendance_records/{reco.description: Daily attendance proof records scoped to the authenticated user.
